comparison.objective: Move the red car through a Rush Hour puzzle; unlike commissioning a robot-axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Likely constrained planar sliding and sequencing among rigid pieces, versus recessed tool insertion, fine rotational adjustment, bimanual stabilization, and locking. Body and specs are absent.
comparison.success_condition: Title implies extracting or freeing the red car; no board configuration, move rules, collision rules, or thresholds are available. Candidate requires two safe impact cycles and post-lock stability.
comparison.reason: Constrained puzzle planning and sliding have a meaningfully different tested outcome from tuning a physical damping response.
